# Vendored Geist

The viewer names Geist / Geist Mono in the `claude` preset (the New York
type pairing used with Lucide chrome). The woff2 faces live next to the
shell so `go:embed` can inline them as `data:` URLs. Metadata stays here so
it is not hashed as a render template.

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Latin variable sans | `internal/render/viewer/template/fonts/geist-latin-wght.woff2` |
| Latin variable mono | `internal/render/viewer/template/fonts/geist-mono-latin-wght.woff2` |
| licence | `LICENSE` (SIL Open Font License 1.1) |
